Codebase review 2026-10-05 on main 3b2211a7bba7fb5699bd7fef3f9bb078bb6866a8. Classification: unimplemented.

The library exposes RecipeInspection and typed recipe-sentence material, but no studio descriptor-form renderer, synthetic-descriptor test, pending UI-A/UI-F display, or DescriptorFormSuite exists.

Evidence:
- plan/src/main/scala/eyes4s/plan/RecipeDescriptors.scala:398 defines RecipeInspection
- docs/studio/IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md:1144 names DescriptorFormSuite
- studio/app/src/main/scala/eyes4s/studio/app/analysis/PresetPicker.scala:58 current recipe pane exposes presets, not a descriptor-driven editor

Remaining / next action: Build descriptor-driven controls and sentence in studio-app/desktop, with synthetic descriptor regression coverage.

Disposition: Keep open.
